FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) = 'asthma'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, vocabulary_id
LIMIT 20

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT asthma.person_id) AS diagnosed_asthma_patients_receiving_budesonide
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009
) asthma
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
  ON de.person_id = asthma.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor dca
  ON dca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
WHERE dca.ancestor_concept_id = 939259
